stories.title: Ponga un Merino en su vida: Mikel rescata a España de las garras de Croacia

en.title: Put a Merino in your life: Mikel rescues Spain from Croatia's grip
en.summary: Spain came from behind to defeat Croatia in a match where Arsenal player Mikel Merino scored twice, with goalkeeper Unai Simón making crucial saves to secure the victory.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: “El seleccionador había incumplido su palabra”

en.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: "The coach had broken his word"
en.summary: Portuguese striker Cristiano Ronaldo speaks publicly for the first time about his dispute with coach Jorge Jesus and his departure from Portugal's national team concentration.

stories.title: Cristiano pide perdón a los portugueses y acusa al seleccionador de faltar a su palabra

en.title: Cristiano apologizes to the Portuguese and accuses the coach of breaking his word
en.summary: The 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo apologized to Portuguese fans in a five-page letter while claiming coach Jorge Jesus broke his word twice, leading him to leave Portugal's squad on September 30 before a Nations League match against Denmark.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo acusa a Jorge Jesus de mentir e incumplir su palabra

en.title: Cristiano Ronaldo accuses Jorge Jesus of lying and breaking his word
en.summary: After publishing a statement apologizing to his teammates, Cristiano Ronaldo claimed the coach broke an agreement and stated the Portuguese Federation asked him not to leave the team after the World Cup, while not ruling out returning to the national squad.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo se sincera sobre su espantada de la selección portuguesa: "Cuando no se cumple la palabra..."

en.title: Cristiano Ronaldo opens up about his departure from Portuguese national team: "When promises aren't kept..."
en.summary: Portuguese forward Cristiano Ronaldo issued a statement explaining his reasons for leaving the national team's training camp.

stories.title: La derecha agita las dudas sobre el voto por correo en el arranque de la precampaña: insta a votar "presencialmente"

en.title: Right-wing parties raise doubts about mail-in voting at start of pre-campaign: urge voting "in person"
en.summary: Vox expresses reservations about mail-in voting while the PP maintains ambiguity regarding this electoral participation method.

stories.title: El Constitucional ampara a los líderes del 'procés' y Llarena levanta la orden de detención contra Puigdemont que podrá regresar ya a España

en.title: Constitutional Court protects 'process' leaders and Llarena lifts detention order against Puigdemont who can now return to Spain
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court ruled in favor of former regional officials involved in Catalonia's independence movement, prompting the Supreme Court judge to lift the arrest warrant against former regional president Puigdemont, allowing him to return to Spain.

stories.title: El decreto de vivienda extiende a 2030 la prohibición de compra especulativa para los fondos buitre

en.title: Housing decree extends ban on speculative purchases by vulture funds until 2030
en.summary: New regulations require appraisal reports to demonstrate transactions do not generate excessive profits and link certain exemptions to future ethics guidelines.

stories.title: Puigdemont mantiene la incógnita sobre su regreso tras la sentencia del Constitucional: “Hoy no se soluciona nada entre Cataluña y España”

en.title: Puigdemont maintains uncertainty about his return following Constitutional Court ruling: "Today nothing is solved between Catalonia and Spain"
en.summary: Former Catalan president Puigdemont reasserts the political significance of his nine years in exile in Belgium without clarifying when he will return to Spain.

stories.title: El Gobierno aprueba 10.000 millones de euros de financiación para la compra de primera vivienda

en.title: Government approves 10 billion euros in financing for first-time home purchases
en.summary: Spain's government has approved 10 billion euros in financing measures for first-time home buyers through new decrees that no longer require parliamentary validation from Junts.

stories.title: Así queda la regulación de la vivienda tras el rescate de los decretos Maricarmen: 10.000 millones de financiación para la compra de la primera vivienda, la prórroga de dos años de los alquileres y el pago público de los costes de los desahucios

en.title: Housing regulation takes shape after rescue of Maricarmen decrees: 10 billion euros in financing for first-home purchases, two-year rental extension, and public coverage of eviction costs
en.summary: New housing measures include 10 billion euros in first-home purchase financing, a two-year extension of rental protections, and public payment of eviction expenses. Implementation requires approval from the Permanent Delegation.

stories.title: El Supremo levanta la orden de detención a Puigdemont, pero no le aplica todavía la amnistía

en.title: Supreme Court lifts detention order for Puigdemont, but does not yet apply amnesty
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge lifted the arrest warrant against the former regional president and two others, but deferred the amnesty decision pending analysis of the Constitutional Court's ruling.

stories.title: Ferrovial se impone a FCC en la mayor autopista checa

en.title: Ferrovial beats FCC in major Czech highway project
en.summary: Ferrovial has won a 2.9 billion euro contract for designing, financing, building, operating and maintaining two sections of the D352 highway in the Czech Republic.

stories.title: El decreto que será convalidado incluye la cuenta europea de inversión

en.title: Decree to be validated includes European investment account
en.summary: A new decree creates an investment account where capital gains remain tax-exempt while held, with full exemption on gains up to 10,000 euros and 20% exemption above that threshold after five years.

stories.title: Francia: entre el mercado de bonos y las barricadas

en.title: France: between the bond market and the barricades
en.summary: France is experiencing significant bond selling ahead of next year's elections, raising concerns among investors about potential impacts on the eurozone.

stories.title: Qué es la Diputación Permanente y por qué es clave para aprobar el decreto de vivienda

en.title: What is the Standing Committee and why is it key to approving the housing decree
en.summary: The Standing Committee is an important institutional mechanism for the approval of the housing decree in Spain.

stories.title: Díaz estrecha el cerco a las empresas que despidan a mayores de 50 años: más controles y sanciones graves

en.title: Díaz tightens the net on companies that dismiss workers over 50: more controls and severe penalties
en.summary: Spain's Labor Ministry is implementing new requirements for profitable companies to report senior worker departures directly to authorities, with penalties reaching 250,000 euros for non-compliance.
